origin: Explosia's LOVEX Reloading Guide 2019 (rifle tables: loads, V5 velocities, pressures; scripts/data/loaddata)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 20 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (6 cartridges), velocity error 7.1 % rms, pressure error 25 % rms (published pressures). Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the type follows the name (S = single base, D = double base)), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data. Fewer data or a poorer fit than most other records: use with more caution.
